Add Python test suite for EC-Lab OLE COM connection stability investigation

Created comprehensive test infrastructure to systematically investigate and resolve the EC-Lab OLE COM auto-disconnect issue observed in the BioLogic SP-150e interface. The device disconnects after ~10-14 seconds of idle time, and this test suite will identify the optimal keep-alive or reconnection strategy.

Test suite includes:
- Baseline auto-disconnect timing measurement
- Keep-alive strategy testing at multiple intervals (1s, 2s, 3s, 5s)
- LoadSettings immediate call testing
- Three reconnection strategies (simple, explicit disconnect, interface recreation)
- Mixed workload simulation matching Battery Exploder initialization pattern

Files added:
- python_testing/eclab_com_test.py - Main test script with 7 test scenarios
- python_testing/eclab_olecom_test_plan.md - Comprehensive test plan documentation
- python_testing/results/ - Directory for test logs
- python_testing/templates/ - Directory for .mps template files

This testing will inform implementation of connection stability fixes in the C codebase.
